BattleEffectText.Name: Poise
BattleEffectText.Desc: Gain {0} x 5% chance to land a Crit. Lose 1 Stack on Critting and at the end of each Scene. Critting will increase the final roll value of the dice by x1.2.

BattleEffectText.Name: Rupture
BattleEffectText.Desc: Take bonus damage when hit equal to {0}. Stack reduces by 1/3rd when hit.

BattleEffectText.Name: Shin (心) - Gray Cinderella
BattleEffectText.Desc: At the start of the Scene, gain a Shield equal to 2% of Max HP per stack.

BattleEffectText.Name: Mang (望) - Gray Cinderella
BattleEffectText.Desc:
At 1 Stack, gain +1 Defensive Dice Power for every 3 Haste (Max 3). Take reduced Damage and Break Damage equal to ((50 + Missing HP%) / 3)%.
At 2 Stacks, when using an Offensive Dice, gain +1 Power for every Speed difference of 2 (Max 3). Critical hits deal +25% more damage.

BattleEffectText.Name: Shin (心) - Gray Cinderella
BattleEffectText.Desc: At the start of the Scene, gain a Shield equal to 7% of Max HP per stack.

BattleEffectText.Name: Mang (望) - Gray Cinderella
BattleEffectText.Desc:
At 1 Stack, gain +1 Defensive Dice Power for every 3 Haste (Max 3). Take reduced Damage and Break Damage equal to ((50 + Missing HP%) / 5)%.
At 2 Stacks, when using an Offensive Dice, gain +1 Power for every Speed difference of 2 (Max 3). Critical hits deal +15% more damage.

BattleEffectText.Name: Let My Name Rock Earth
BattleEffectText.Desc: Inflict 2 Bind to all enemies at the start of each Scene. Deal 1 extra damage against slower targets. Gain 1 Paralyze at a (Speed difference x 10)% chance upon losing a Clash against a target with slower Speed (max, 3 Paralyze per Page).

BattleEffectText.Name: Let My Name Shake Heaven and Earth
BattleEffectText.Desc: Inflict 2 Bind and 1 Feeble to all enemies at the start of each Scene. Deal 3 extra damage against slower targets. Gain 1 Paralyze at a (Speed difference x 10)% chance upon losing a Clash against a target with slower Speed (max, 3 Paralyze per Page).

BattleEffectText.Name: Craving Monster
BattleEffectText.Desc:
On using a Combat Page, restore 1 Light.
Receive 1 less damage and stagger damage from all sources (Including damage from non-attacks).
All offensive dice gain the following effect: [On Hit] Heal own HP equal to the Rupture stacks on target. This does not trigger when you are currently above 80% HP.

BattleEffectText.Name: Hungry Monster
BattleEffectText.Desc:
On using a Combat Page, restore 1-2 Light.
Receive 2 less damage and stagger damage from all sources (Including damage from non-attacks).
All offensive dice gain the following effect: [On Hit] Heal own HP equal to 1.5x the Rupture stacks on target. This does not trigger when you are currently above 60% HP.

BattleEffectText.Name: Starved Monster
BattleEffectText.Desc:
On using a Combat Page, restore 1-3 Light and have a 33% chance to draw 1 Page. All Dice on this character gain +1 Min and +1 Max value.
Receive 3 less damage and stagger damage from all sources (Including damage from non-attacks).
All offensive dice gain the following effect: [On Hit] Heal own HP equal to 2x the Rupture stacks on target. This does not trigger when you are currently above 40% HP.

BattleEffectText.Name: The Gray Cinderella
BattleEffectText.Desc:
Restore 2 HP and Stagger Resist on clash win with any die.
If HP is greater than 75%, also gain “Let My Name Rock Earth”.
At the start of each Scene, gain 1 Poise for every 35% missing HP, and gain 1 Haste for every 50% missing HP.

BattleEffectText.Name: The Ashen Monster
BattleEffectText.Desc:
Restore 3 HP and Stagger Resist while inflicting 1 Rupture to the target on clash win with any die.
If HP is greater than 60%, also gain “Let My Name Shake Heaven and Earth”.
At the start of each Scene, gain 1 Poise for every 25% missing HP, and gain 1 Haste for every 35% missing HP.
